description: Labelled questions for the two SYNTHETIC sample PDFs produced by `python -m evaluation.sample_docs`. Each answerable item names the file and page that holds the answer, and an evidence_phrase that is checked against the extracted text on every run. Run: python -m evaluation.run_eval --pdf ..\samples\sample_api_testing_notes.pdf ..\samples\sample_cicd_pipeline_notes.pdf --dataset evaluation\sample_dataset.json
